title: Confirm training-session audio and Wi‑Fi availability before starting slides
summary: Before starting the Day 1 training slides, confirm that attendees can hear the presenter and that the only available Wi‑Fi network is the one identified as “PS Wi‑Fi.”
when_to_use: Use this pre-start check immediately before beginning the training slides when the presenter needs to ensure attendees can hear them and when Wi‑Fi availability may affect connectivity expectations.
roles_and_responsibilities: Presenter/training lead (operator): ask attendees if they can hear and confirm the available Wi‑Fi network name (“PS Wi‑Fi”).
access_or_tools_needed: In-room audio (speaker/microphone) sufficient for attendees to hear
Wi‑Fi network availability (specifically “PS Wi‑Fi” as mentioned in the segment)

visual_references.description: Frame around the audio/Wi‑Fi pre-start check: “Can y’all hear me?” and “I don't have Wi‑Fi here, only PS Wi‑Fi.”

steps.title: Ask attendees whether they can hear the presenter
steps.purpose: Ensure attendees can hear the presenter before starting the slides.
steps.instruction: Before the slides start, ask the room: “Can y'all hear me?”
steps.expected_result: Attendees respond that they can hear the presenter (or indicate they cannot).
steps.healthy_condition: Attendees confirm they can hear you clearly enough to proceed with the slides.
steps.failure_condition: Attendees indicate they cannot hear you.
stop_or_escalate_if: If attendees cannot hear, pause and re-check room audio before continuing the slides.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Near this frame: "Can y'all hear me?" and "I don't have Wi‑Fi here, only PS Wi‑Fi."

steps.title: Confirm the available Wi‑Fi network name (“PS Wi‑Fi”)
steps.purpose: Set correct expectations for connectivity by confirming which Wi‑Fi network is available.
steps.instruction: If Wi‑Fi is needed, confirm that the only available network is “PS Wi‑Fi” (and that the presenter does not have Wi‑Fi other than PS Wi‑Fi).
steps.expected_result: The available Wi‑Fi network is identified as “PS Wi‑Fi,” with no other Wi‑Fi available per the segment.
steps.healthy_condition: Attendees understand that connectivity expectations should be based on “PS Wi‑Fi” only.
steps.failure_condition: The needed Wi‑Fi is not available beyond “PS Wi‑Fi,” requiring adjustment of connectivity expectations.

actions.label: State Wi‑Fi availability
actions.exact_action: “I don't have Wi‑Fi here, only PS Wi‑Fi.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the needed Wi‑Fi is not available beyond “PS Wi‑Fi,” adjust expectations for connectivity before continuing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: "I don't have Wi‑Fi here, only PS Wi‑Fi."
Near this frame: "Can y'all hear me?" and "I don't have Wi‑Fi here, only PS Wi‑Fi."

steps.title: Proceed to the slides once audio is confirmed and attendees are ready
steps.purpose: Transition from pre-start checks into the training slides.
steps.instruction: After audio is confirmed and attendees are ready, start the training slides (transition into the presenter introduction).
steps.expected_result: The session transitions into the slides/training start (e.g., “All right, we'll get started”).
steps.healthy_condition: The presenter begins the training slides after receiving audio confirmation.
steps.failure_condition: Starting slides before audio is confirmed leads to attendee inability to follow along.
stop_or_escalate_if: If audio is not confirmed, pause and re-check room audio before continuing the slides.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Segment transitions with: "All right, we'll get started" and includes presenter introduction.
“All right, we'll get started. My name is Mitchell Flynn. This is Akron. We'll be going through this morning's slides.”

success_criteria: Attendees confirm they can hear the presenter.
Wi‑Fi availability is identified as “PS Wi‑Fi” (with no other Wi‑Fi available per the segment).
Training slides begin after the above confirmations.
healthy_conditions: Room audio is sufficient for attendees to hear the presenter.
Connectivity expectations are aligned to “PS Wi‑Fi” only.
failure_conditions: Wi‑Fi needed for the session is not available beyond “PS Wi‑Fi.”
escalation_guidance: If attendees cannot hear, pause and re-check room audio before continuing the slides.
If the needed Wi‑Fi is not available beyond “PS Wi‑Fi,” adjust connectivity expectations before continuing.
